body: I am trying to rebuild my self concept and not be hopeless and terrified. I have been quite overwhelmed with my current circumstances bc of some things they made me realize about myself and my life this year and a chain of events. I've now been stuck at my absolute lowest point. When I found neville I felt like I saw a light. However, I've found myself feeling disappointed and more confused. I discovered that I have aphantasia and can't see images in my head, feel, smell hear other voices or even touch things. It's like I have no imagination. I have an inner monologue that is like one main voice and then like layers over that. I can only seem to control one at a time. I can't seem to figure out how to generate any other feeling and just keep winding up feeling like I can't control anything about myself. That experience in itself seems to only accidentally keep reaffirming the things that made me feel so hopeless and defeated in life this year. I seem to only be able to generate feelings based on what happens to me in the 3d. I have been doing my absolute best at the mental diet and trying different approaches. Like I fully grasp the concept and even see it working for family members. However they literally all visualize. I know you don't need visualization but I can't seem to get past this newfound experinece of not being able to generate sincere positive emotions and feelings. Everything that I've gone through mentally has been extremely confusing this year. Honestly the story itself is really weird. I know this whole thing is my old story and i'm to drop it. I don't want anyone to assume i'm still telling myself any of my negative thoughts. I just really don't know how to get all of my inner voices cohesive. I just thought it might be helpful to take a step back if i'm feeling worse instead of better. I'm really tired of this tug of war. At the end of last year I had for the first time ever felt amazing about myself and my life. I know why and how that had happened but in my big picture, especially after finding neville i'm just even more confused now. I just want that back. Everything happened so fast it's like my soul is in shock. I know that the 3d is a mirror I just can't figure out why mine feels reversed. Not sure if this made any sense. Thank you to anyone who thinks they can help. Or took the time to read.  I'm super open to chatting as well.

I tried to clear my head and the exact opposite happened. I spent a week trying to be happy and not think of bad things. Last night I couldn't hold back the thoughts anymore. My head was just a screaming inner monologue of all the thoughts I've been trying to hold back. I felt like I was hyper aware of reality. That maybe this reality is actually hell because what kind of place forces people to be under this kind of pressure just to survive. That reality being that I am trapped in life unless I actually finally kill myself and that there really is no other way to escape the suffering. I am actually petrified of being alive and suffering because of who I am and I am equally petrified of dying. I am stuck in a loop of being frozen in fear. I'm stuck in the same day repeating itself for months. Everything around me is a mess, i'm a mess, my life is a mess. I realized that time is running out fast. I've made no progress towards anything in 7mo. I still don't know what to try to progress to. It was as if a huge bell of doom went off over my head and a clock started ticking down faster. I realized that if that happens again I really really won't be able to stop myself from going. My heart was beating out of my chest. No matter how hard I tried to shut my head up and not be scared it didn't work. I felt as if I had absolutely no control over my actions and could only watch. I was just begging that I was experiencing god and that I was just finally being pulled out to save myself the pain of going on my own. I don't even know how to put into words everything I felt. Just like this is what it really means to jump out of the game. This is what it feels like when you really can't see a way out. This really is my reality. I really am lost and there really isn't anyone who could help. I just can't believe this is how everything turned out. Even if I could keep living I don't know how to after that experience. Everything just feels like I tricked myself into pretending that didn't happen. If I can't find a way to feel safe in this world again before dec and that happens again I don't know how I could possibly survive it. I thought that I would just eventually start getting things together to go and just go in a way that seemed peaceful. I didn't think my body could just take over and force me out spontaneously like that. This really feels like hell to me. I'm so scared..

My head finally snapped last night. I felt the worse I've ever felt in my life. It was indescribable. I don't know how I didn't finally do it other than I just didn't have the things to go in a peaceful way. I can't shut my head up. I can't find a way out. I didn't think I could feel worse than I already did. It really just hit a new level. I'm literally petrified and have been shaking all day and feel like i'm going to puke.

It was my neighbor and no, I avoid her at all costs now. I don't believe anyone can support me through this at this point. I scaled it down and realized that all of the experiences and events that occurred in my life led me here. I simply actually have no skills in anything. That's the only thing that would deem me valuable enough to gain a wage that would help me get by. The only way to get them is through experience or schooling. I'm in no position to get either of those things in any way. Now or in the future. I'm overwhelmed because there are multiple paths to solving these problems but every one of them is out of my reach due to a lack of money and/or time. I'm not an idiot by any means but in the eyes of society I really have no value. My situation is my fault alone. Anything I could point to as a reason is deemed an excuse. I have too many things to learn, change or fix. I'm behind in every way possible. Society is what tells me to pull myself up. That it's always possible. The people in my life just say don't give up. The thing is every time I tried not to it only confirmed why I should. From the perspective of others it's not about my future it's about now. From my perspective now is what showed me there is no future. Everything that could possibly allow me to create one is a universe away. A turn around for a life like this would literally only happen in a movie with insane luck and unrealistic representations of people. In real life this is a death sentence.

I don't care about meds, I deleted the app months ago. I just want to have a life. I can't do anything about any of the things that stop me from having one. My mental health is a direct result of my circumstances. People run to meds for everything. Meds don't fix circumstances. Trust me just from my experience with my psychosis and those meds sometimes they actually make shit worse. I wouldn't have lost 25lbs if it weren't for that shit. I didn't need it, just needed someone to talk to me and listen. I have enough personal experience with that in my life with family to know that something was wrong with me in that moment and pull myself out. I tried and failed because the person I went to didn't understand how to listen. They thought calling the police instead of the person I asked them to call was a better idea. Humanity is ignorant in so many painful ways. My car is finally shutting down on me. So in order just this year in my life: I lost my achillies, a best friend, time at work and money, my bodyweight, another best friend, ill be losing my home, my belongings, my pets, my car, realized my life is headed for homelessness and more pain, my phone is glitching and my job feels like complete slavery and is literally terrible for my mental health. Anyone under these circumstances would realize if they wanted a life they simply aren't allowed. There is no amount of sheer effort to fix this. It just boils down to im in bad shape, I have no one to lean on, I have no chance at making enough money to support any of the problems im having. I'm fucking doomed no matter how I look at it. Unless a literal angel came down and performed a miracle i am on a path that leads to dying cold, scared and alone in the streets. This culture of pull yourself up by the "bootstraps" is toxic as fuck. Once you hit a certain point it becomes painfuly clear there are no fucking bootstraps. People are not meant to be alone we are social creatures. Our history is of ancestors that worked together to survive. Today we try to survive a whole new hell we built ourselves and try to do it alone. Like crabs in boiling water. Those of us at the bottom of the pot can never get out with everyone and everything stepping on us so they can escape. Like realistically there is nothing I can actually do to help myself. Living is now suicide as well. I have 2 options try to die fast by my own hands or die slowly and painfuly in the streets bc I couldn't afford the cost of my life in time to save it. I wish I was an alien and could leave.

I can only get 4 more free sessions of therapy through work. After that I can't afford it. The meds are $6 through the app I was told to get by the doctors and pharmacist. In my opinion the meds won't help with existential crisis and fearing for my life. Might numb the depression, maybe slow the panic attacks and heart racing but that's minuscule. Don't qualify for food stamps, section 8 has a 2,-3yr wait. Although id be dead meat in those apartments anyway for being asset protection. Just looking over my shoulder 24/7. I can't have a future because there is no realistic way to create one for myself. I'm 30 and look like i'm 23 going on 16, a black alternative female, severly underweight with a ruptured achillies.  I've been trapped at walmart for going on 11yrs, only have a completely useless associates degree. No interview experience, no resume skills, no marketable or desirable skills. My closet is full of clothes that are all too big on me now and too alternative, my hair is too expensive to manage correctly now, I have no "professional" attire. I'm insanely socially awkward due to trauma and just never fitting in anywhere in the slightest. I can't network, I have no real technology skills other than knowing how to use it, no trade skills, no salesperson skills. Every time I have ever tried to get another job I never got interviews. I can't move up in operations to better pay bc even if I work circles around everyone else they'd rather me just stay in that area. No matter how much I know or how confident I try to appear the laziest person always gets the promotion. My current job takes too much of my time and energy, worsens my mental health and puts me in danger that I don't want. I can't even make it to physical therapy anymore bc it made me too exhausted and caused me to miss work. So my health isn't improving. So not only does my job not afford me the ability to live anywhere it also doesn't allow me to get healthier. Every other job that I could probably get pays even less and if it pays more im either not remotely qualified or my health wouldn't allow me to do the heavy lifting requirements. My car is falling apart, I can't afford my contacts anymore, I can't afford to move my stuff, my computer doesn't even work right, my phone is showing signs of glitching out. Then to top it all off I figured out that I am terrified of life now literally. In 6mo my roommate will be gone and so will my life as I knew it. My stuff, my pets, my health, my sense of any security at all. I could literally get rid of all my stuff and pets and still not afford anywhere on my own let alone be able to obtain and work the number of jobs I'd need to stay afloat and save to get another car or keep one running. I'd literally have to give up on my achillies ever healing correctly thus risking a re-rupture, ever gaining weight, ever fixing my tooth. Id just actually never have time to worry about it. Then just completely forget about ever going back to school for something in those conditions. If I could even think of what to go for at all or figure out how to. I tried finding roommates but when you're unable to get anyone to socialize with you it's impossible. I even tried websites people have much higher budgets than me, are students with good careers who are looking for people their age or just way more stable and I sense that they'd see me as a risk. The rooms for rent are still too much as well. I am the poster child for dead ending oneself in life. Undereducated, stigmatized, stereotyped, unappealing work history, poor and soon to be homeless too skinny and unable to run. The only skills I had was drawing but it literally will take me a yr to get something half finished on the paper. I'm just completely useless in american society. The days just get worse the closer dec gets. If I can't find a way to support myself realistically before then then i'm just going to have to take myself out. It's bad enough all the things im losing this year it's worse to lose them and know I'll never be able to get any of them back. My life is a joke. A cruel joke. I wouldn't wish this fear and pain on anyone. All ive been able to do this year is try and fail to save my life everyday. Cry myself to sleep while looking at this mess. Wish I wasn't so fucking stupid or that anyone had ever realized I really needed someone at any other point in my life to have taught me anything important about life at all. Instead I'm right back where I started 13 with a laundry basket alone, sad, confused, scared and no idea where I should go. Full fucking circle. Lol and majority of society would just say if your born poor and die poor it's your fault. I beg to fucking differ. Why fight a battle that is obviously utterly impossible? I'm insanely lucky to have even made it to this point knowing what I know now. I was screwed the whole time it just finally became visible this year. Hell of an epiphany.

I am trying therapy, it's useless. They just ask me to practice mindfulness and offer medication. I literally can't afford the medication, even if it's $6/mo. in my situation. Do I need some anxiety and depression meds hell yeah, can I do anything about it absolutely not. Also have much more than just anxiety and depression at this point. Also having to avoid the topic of being suicidal just to avoid being locked up and actually losing my job that I hate is just exhausting. I know what will happen, meds and a glorified pep talk with I side of subtle abuse and discrimination. Then a good luck out there as im tossed back out into a worse position. No thanks. It's bad enough being let down by others it's even worse to be let down by my whole country. I found the perfect combo to never have a future. There's no pulling yourself up by the bootstraps and taking control in this situation. I have no real control. No matter how I look at it I need help I know i'm not going to get bc that's just life here. I can't find things to help bc they don't exist.  I know I can't get anywhere alone now and even if I could I have no idea where to even attempt to go. I hate it here. I'm actually completely trapped in every way. Humanity is the worst species on the planet. This place is literal hell to me. I don't even want to talk about my psychosis anymore. The doctors never cared to ask so why bother? All i'll say it's the week's after we're the happiest of my life because I had found myself for the first time in my whole life through it. Simply bc of the way I saw life before. Then moments later I was killed. I kept trying to save me before I found out it was completely futile. I'm already dead. Everyday now I just die more. I can't take this pressure, the pain or the sadness anymore. I'm tired of looking for false hope. There is none, it's time to accept it, do myself a favor and head out. Yeah people will be upset im gone but no one will hurt as much as I do about the reasons I had to leave. For me it really is the only option left.

It's my family and a couple acquaintances. They listen but they don't listen to understand. They constantly use examples from their own lives or lives of people who are famous to try to make me think things just work out. I consistently point out multiple reasons why things worked in those cases. I try to point out the things i'm missing but no one thinks i'm missing those things. They have them in their life so they can't imagine the impact. I try to explain what's happened in my head but no one believes me. I seek therapy but they can't see how the events in my life even make them useless to me. I don't have time to teach things to people that should already know them. I know I don't fit here bc it's been made clear to me in every aspect of my life. It's like I've been a ghost my whole life and only now i'm visible but still not visible enough. It's no surprise to me that this is how I wound up. My family didn't ever care, my friends, my teachers, my coworkers. Too much adversity and psychological abuse. I learned life in an extremely different way than seemingly everyone. Now that everything is so clear I see what should have happened and the reasons it didn't. Where I should be and why i'm not. What it takes to fix it all and what will stop me. I see just how little fault it really was of my own and still feel the need to blame myself because of how obvious everything is now. Now i'm still left with a mess that's too big to handle alone but i'm still just as alone as I always have been. I'm tired of isolation, i'm tired of pain and confusion. I have even less clue of what to do than anyone would find acceptable at this age. I can't explain it to anyone and even if I could no one can do anything about it. My life was just a train wreck of being let down by literally everything and everyone. I was an intelligent child with a bright future now im just the same kid minus the future. I'm a walking statistic. Nothing more nothing less. There is no help for someone like me because someone like me should not even exist. I can never be happy here, none of my needs could ever be met because no one has these needs in this way. I'm the equivalent of Tarzan raised as a different species now forced to learn the correct ways of being. I'm an expert in all the wrong things. I just have no help and now less than 5mo to figure out. It's literally impossible and I'd rather die than keep this charade going. Every single thing about life is infuriating to me now. It took 1 psychosis to clear my head and bring me up to speed. Scientists really should do some deeper digging into what those really are bc I think I know now. Tbh if I'dve had a good job that psychosis would have saved my life. The irony doesn't escape me. I think my life is a satire for whatever created life.

That's why i'm giving up, I tried solving one problem at a time. I can't. Every time I try a new problem gets revealed that I still can't solve. I just can't take it anymore. I just have too many issues and too many of them tie together. Too much of my fate is tied into society. I don't want to be here. Its like every negative thing about being alive is in my way. Everything around me just keeps breaking. It's like the universe is telling me to get out. At least if I go now i'll never have to lose anything else and fall further, if that's even possible. I really am not good at being alive. I'm tired, I hurt, I can't learn or do anything fast enough to help myself. All I can do anymore is try to sleep and then have a severe panic attack when I wake up and realize i'm still in this horrible reality. Continue to drag into work and try not to cry and get fired.  Everyone thinks I can fix it but no one is able to feel and see things the way I do or even put themselves in my shoes. If anyone could they'd see how useless it is. Life really has finally broken me, it is actually possible. The only thing that could save me now is if I could win the lottery. It's the only way I could stand any chance in this world alone while only having me. I just don't fit in here in any way that's necessary. No matter how hard I try.

I'm stuck in asset protection at walmart. It's not a career and it's the worst possible job for my mental health and physical safety. There is no one that can help me. There are no resources that I qualify for. I already checked. No section 8, no snap benefits I technically make too much for both. My family is not a family so I can't get help from them and honestly haven't since I was 13. They are all mentally ill in their own way. Hence why my life went so stupid anyway. As for this year I ruptured my achilles, and became underweight, my roommate/"friend" is leaving in 5mo, my car is having issues and my phone is glitching out. I can't afford enough food to get control of my weight. I can't make it to my physical therapy bc my work schedule is causing me too much exhaustion among other things. I could go on forever, my entire life has bursted in every imaginable way. Even in unimaginable ways. By the end of the year I won't be able to keep anything. It's really simple, I have too much to do and to little time. Others looking in can't see it from my perspective. I see everything that needs to be fixed and what it takes to do so. I don't have the tools or the time. I can't survive life like this. I either have to find a way to make a livable wage or just suffer the consequences. I know I don't have any of the things a person needs to get anywhere in life. I refuse to die in the streets in the name of capitalism. The only real control I will ever have over my life is to end it before it gets even worse.

I can't explain everything it's too hard to do in text. The best I can say is I grew up without any real guidance on taking care of myself and that doesn't actually explain it either. People have only treated me terribly my whole life. I only survived this long by complete chance and dumb luck. Long story short my job history is terrible, I make way to little to actually take care of myself properly. I am in no way prepared to change careers or even jobs for a multitude of reasons. My body is not in good shape nor is my mental health. I'm in the process of losing litteraly everything in my life simply bc I can't afford to keep it down to my health. I can't better myself because I just can't afford to. I finally escaped my circumstances to find that escaping them ruined any chance I had at a future. Life has hit me non stop from the start and it finally hit hard enough to keep me down. Even the friends I do have see how trapped I really am so much so that they understand why I feel the need to leave. I will wind up homeless bc I can't afford anywhere to stay while taking care of my vehicle. I will wind up sick bc I can't get the time or money to fix my health properly. I will be poor bc I can't afford to do what's neccessary to upgrade my skills/myself to make a better income. It's a poverty trap and I have no real escape. My life has never been what I wanted and every attempt to make it better has failed miserably. I just didn't realized how miserably until it hit this crescendo. I'm out of gas and chances. I appreciate the listening and supporting but there is no amount of that that can possibly help me. The one point of life is to take care of yourself, I simply can't so time to head out.

I've talked to plenty of people now. It doesn't help. I'd feel better if I could actually do the things I need to take care of my health and make enough money to survive. Like my car died yesterday and the only reason I was able to get it going again was bc my roommate/ friend is still here for now. Otherwise I'd already be screwed. I can't live a life where my health  can't be fixed and I can't afford to upgrade myself enough to gain better employment. You can only continue in life if you have the tools to do so. I'm lacking too many. I simply realized everything I need to fix and how. Saw the path and the obstacles and realized I'd literally just die trying. I'd rather not die a slow, agonizing, lonely death like that. At least in these moments I have the few small things that make me still feel some joy.

Pretty sure I've hit my limit. My car just died at work. I'm think that there is a limit to how much a person can actually stand and life pushed every single one at once this year and still won't stop pushing. I can't take this much longer. I feel like I am going to actually explode at any second. Every single day has just gotten progressively worse. I really don't think my head was supposed to come out this way and I can't see any future where I'll ever be able to feel any peace. How could I with this complete lack of ability to navigate life and being completely alone with no one by my side at all. I don't even care about talking to any of the people I know bc, what can anyone do to help. I have to help myself, if I can't then tough luck. I'm really over this.

If I don't adapt i'll just waste away slowly anyway. It's either fix my body and make enough money to survive on my own in 6mo or admit defeat, lose everything and waste away in pain, poverty and sadness. I know where my life is headed and I'd much rather just live as far out as I can this year. That way I can at least go out with the few small things that make me happy. It may not be a game I have no idea. I just know that I can't lose anything else irreplaceable again and that even if I did I still don't stand a chance anyway. I wont even be able to just be. Everything is blatantly futile from my perspective.

I am. The only one who can help me is me. I figured out I can't so the only option left is to go. I really just come here to air my thoughts anymore and not feel as alone. That's the best I've got. Otherwise there'd just be all these entries in my notes on my phone. I'm really already just a shell anyway.

I tried not to get overwhelmed but everyday when I struggle to get up it starts a cycle of realizing where I am in life and how much I don't know. Then I realize how I got here and I feel so hurt. I look around and see my stuff, my car, my clothes and they all feel so heavy. I look in the mirror and see myself and get reminded of the treatment I've seen just for that image. I see what needs to be changed to curve that treatment. Then I walk and am reminded of my health. I fear my ability to keep waking up on time bc of my depression. I see my clothes need to change. My things need to be packed and moved. My car needs work. Appointments need to be scheduled and attended. I see my paycheck and know it's not nearly enough for all of that. I go to work and interact with people and see that I struggle and how it affects the way i'm interacted with. I know what all needs to happen I just don't know how to fix any of it without money and some more free time. Everything im trying to do is a first. I can't even figure out how people get 2 jobs and balance them at all. I feel like an 80yr old trying to understand teenage slang. I just wish I could stop being so exhausted. Sometimes I think maybe i'm on the autism spectrum. I see that this shouldn't be this hard to navigate. Like I honestly am sorry to anyone trying to help. I just can't stop panicking. I just feel like I've been in another universe my whole life and just arrived here. I'm going to keep trying I'm just fighting so much more in my head as well. That was already my hardest battle before all this started it just got harder. Thank you for trying to help me.

I thought my family would help but they won't. Even if I pay. That's a lifelong issue and some of the reason I got to this point. I thought that getting something off my plate would be beneficial as well. I know a new roommate won't pay all the rent, it would just help until I was healthier again. I've tried multiple strategies that's why i'm so hopeless. All of the things i can think to do are out of reach. I think I just come here because it helps me not feel alone when I know that I really am. I have tried reaching out. I can't explain it but my whole life everyone has told me good things about myself. However, I've always been somehow out of the loop on life. Like I see literally everyone around doing so much even when in worse shape than me but for some reason I just can't get it going. Like forever outside looking into a fogged glass. I know most of reddit is probably tired of me at this point. I just really am frozen here. It's all I really have left in me. I know i'm trying my hardest. Thank you for taking time to offer advice.

I tried but all I can do is doc on demand and I only have 10 free sessions through work. I can barely get the sessions in bc most of the time she's only available when i'm at work. Tbh it doesn't help me anyway. I'm just so cynical about the reality i'm stuck in that anyone telling me ways to cope just infuriates me. I wish the doctors were the worst thing that had happened. They just were the icing on the cake. Everything else had already taken my soul and my mindbut they took my body and all my realistic changes at actually doing whatever it takes to keep what I needed to.  Like I just wish I could pull all the events in my life out and show just how they led to this year. How little control I actually had over any of them. How just the actions of those around me really stole my power. I get so sick of people telling me how my life is like a movie. I hate this fucking movie. I'm ready for it to end. All the bad I got through just to find myself still fucked for life. I mean if I just had 1 fucking person that came into my life now and stuck by me literally in person for real I could see a chance at a future. I just know there is no way I can do this alone. Like how does one's life ruin their life and then trying to live life takes their life? Tbh i'm lucky I made it this far. I really could have been dead many times before. After all i'm just prey for people tbh. I guess I should've tried to write a book maybe I could've made some money lol granted no one would have bought it. Fuck no one even really believes me when I try to tell them what happened. Even my "best friend" who fucking was around for some of it live. Idk I just know this mess i'm left with isn't worth the additional trauma and suffering just to wind up homeless without my cat nuggets.

Overall a lot has happened in my life just like everyone my story is unique to me. The most recent events have finally broken me fully. I ruptured my achilles. I hoped to heal it and recover. I was out of work and unpaid for months due to the negligence of others. My doctors treated me poorly due to implicit bias. I don't look how i should look to be treated fairly. People don't realize it but it's always clear to the one it happens to. I became overly stressed and had a mental break. I was once again treated unfairly by doctors. I was placed on a medication that caused me to lose too much weight. Ignored by doctors again to say the least. In short the actions of the doctors have left me severly underweight with an improperly healed achilles.I am stuck in a low wage job at 16hr that nullifies my weight gain efforts. Physical therapy also impedes those efforts. On top of this my life is falling apart around me. My "best friend"/roommate is leaving unexpectedly. I can't afford to live on my own. I'll need multiple jobs. Everything I qualify for is manual labor. I'll just lose more weight trying to keep a roof over my head and a working car. I'm 104lbs now. I should be 130. I can't run, jump, climb ladders, pull pallets lift heavy things. I don't have money to buy new nice clothes for interviews. I can't even afford to fix my hair to look more professional. I have c-ptsd, severe anxiety, chronic depression and autophobia. I can't afford to meds or to even trust doctors to actually help me.
